original_value: In order to improve the accuracy of structured road boundary detection and solve the problem of the poor robustness of single feature boundary extraction, this paper proposes a multi-feature road boundary detection algorithm based on HDL-32E LIDAR. According to the road environment and sensor information, the former scenic cloud data is extracted, and the primary and secondary search windows are set according to the road geometric features and the point cloud spatial distribution features. In the search process, we propose the concept of the largest and smallest cluster points set and a two-way search method. Finally, the quadratic curve model is used to fit the road boundary. In the actual road test in the campus road, the accuracy of the linear boundary detection is 97.54%, the accuracy of the curve boundary detection is 92.56%, and the average detection period is 41.8 ms. In addition, the algorithm is still robust in a typical complex road environment.

result.paraphrase: To improve structured road boundary detection accuracy and address the weak robustness of single-feature boundary extraction, this paper presents a multi-feature road boundary detection algorithm based on HDL-32E LIDAR. Based on the road environment and sensor data, the former scenic cloud data are extracted, and primary and secondary search windows are defined according to road geometric characteristics and the spatial distribution of point cloud features. During the search, the concepts of the largest and smallest cluster point sets and a bidirectional search method are introduced. Finally, a quadratic curve model is used to fit the road boundary. In campus road tests, the linear boundary detection accuracy is 97.54%, the curve boundary detection accuracy is 92.56%, and the average detection period is 41.8 ms. The algorithm also remains robust in typical complex road environments.
